entry.summary:
<div class="callout-note callout--no-title" role="note">
<p><strong>Note:</strong> As of March 2023, the Department of Internal Affairs (DIA) has concluded the digital inclusion programme.</p>
<p>While digital inclusion remains an important issue for Aotearoa New Zealand, DIA currently has no sustainable funding to progress this work.</p>
<p>We appreciate the support and interest shown in digital inclusion through the course of this programme — thanks for being part of its journey.</p>
</div>
<p>The purpose of this research was to understand the perceptions and feelings about digital inclusion from people with disabilities as they go about their daily lives.</p>
<p>The goal was to understand the key pain points for individuals, what they liked about the current system and what improvements could be made to ensure a more equitable digital environment for all.</p>
<p>The report includes insights from disabled people and&nbsp;5 recommendations for Government on how to increase digital inclusion.</p>
<div class="callout-note">
<h2>Read the full report</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/dmsdocument/170~digital-inclusion-user-insights-for-disabled-people/html">Digital inclusion user insights — Disabled people</a></p>
</div>
<h2>Summary of the report</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/dmsdocument/192~summary-of-digital-inclusion-user-insights-disabled-people-report/html">Summary of Digital inclusion user insights — Disabled people report</a></p>
<h3>Alternate formats</h3>
<p>The summary of the report is available in the following formats.</p>

<h4>Large print</h4>
